services.name: one hour Tiki Boat public tour
services.desc: Come and join us for one hour in the only floating Tiki boat in Kelowna!

explain.meaning: You join other guests on the same trip.

services.name: Banana Boat Tour
services.desc: is One of the most exciting, fun-filled tours in Kelowna. This thrilling ride in a sausage-shaped, inflated raft is towed by a speed boat, challenging participants to hold and avoid the almost unavoidable fall to the water. (fall to the water is optional) Lifejackets are a must.

explain.meaning: A long inflatable seating several riders, towed behind a boat.

services.name: Tiki BUS#1: Wine Tours (Kelowna and West Side Trail)
services.desc: For true wine lovers! Our Kelowna wine tours allow you to travel from winery to winery sampling an endless variety of wines in a fun and unique Tiki Bus. Looking to explore somewhere new? Try our West Side Trail wine tours and visit some of the area's newest winery additions.

services.name: Tiki wagon: Wine Tours
services.desc: For the true wine lovers! Our Kelowna wine tours allow you to travel from winery to winery sampling an endless variety of wines in a fun and unique Tiki Wagon. Looking to explore somewhere new? Try our West Side Trail wine tours and visit some of the area's newest winery additions.

services.name: Flyboard Kelowna per person
services.desc: Always wanted to try fly boarding, but no one to go with? We got your covered! Jump in solo and meet some other like-minded new friends or bring another friend along or the whole family. This experience is suited for anyone looking to learn this fun, new water sport.

explain.meaning: You stand on a board lifted into the air by jets of water.

services.name: Tiki Bus #1: Wine & Cider Tour
services.desc: Explore Okanagan's most popular wineries, craft breweries & cideries with our Tiki-themed Kelowna Wine, Brewery & Cider tour. This tour has something for everyone. Join us on our Tiki-themed bus to visit two wineries of your choice, one brewery and one cidery.

services.name: 1-Hour Guided PonTiki Lake Cruise with Captain
services.desc: Enjoying Kelowna from the water is a wonderful and relaxing experience! Perfect for the whole family including your pets. Enjoy Cruising at a relaxed speed taking in some of the most beautiful scenery in the Okanagan. Our boat comfortably accommodates 10 passengers on a beautiful stable, covered tri-toon vessel.
